lines.text: The people are told to blow the ram's horn and flee to the fortified cities because disaster comes from the north.
The people are told to put on armor and mourn, and Jeremiah says they were promised peace.
A voice from Dan proclaims disaster, and an army surrounds Jerusalem because she has rebelled against the LORD.
Jeremiah sees the earth formless and void, the mountains quaking, and the fruitful land turned into a forest.
Her lovers despise her and want her life, and the Daughter of Zion says her soul faints before murderers.
